### Today's Insight - December 31, 2012: Leave It to God
Author: Charles R. Swindoll  
Site: Crosswalk.com  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-december-31-2012.html  
Passage: Isaiah 32:17  
Points:
- God's righteousness promises enduring quietness, confidence, and peace.
- Life brings persistent worries over health, children, careers, and unmet expectations.
- Striving to control difficult outcomes only fuels spiritual anxiety and frustration.
- True peace comes from actively surrendering every burdensome situation to God.
